# EPC media migration fixtures

These fixtures retain the native EN/DE page markup and scripts used by the
media planner, including all fourteen images, both videos, their exact old
controller, the complete shared About/Services/EPC photo helper and links.
Only style blocks are omitted because the planner never edits styles. They
come from the current isolated native page shape with the audited media-old
state; the current German contact-context attributes are retained. They are
HTML input data, not an alternate runtime implementation. No credentials or
customer submissions are included.

The tests exercise both complete language pairs and deliberate structural or
media-policy drift. Whole non-media text, anchors, and unrelated script bytes
are preservation controls. Added backslash probes are test-only content and
must survive unchanged. These fixtures do not prove WordPress transactions,
translation baseline adoption, browser playback or production performance.
